entities.summary: Paul Joseph D. Conlin is a Canadian ice hockey player who played for the St. Michael's Majors and Canadian national team. He scored the game-winning goal in the 1961 Memorial Cup for the St. Mike's Majors. He played for Canada in the 1964 and 1968 Olympics and won a bronze medal at the 1968 Winter Olympics. He is a lawyer practising in Ottawa, Ontario. In 2012 he was inducted into the Lucan Hall of Fame.
